title: Ameresco to Participate at Upcoming Conference
summary: Ameresco Ameresco to Participate at Upcoming Conference Press Release
body_markdown:
- On November 10, 2026, Ameresco Co-President, Nicole Bulgarino, and Senior Vice President and Chief Marketing Officer, Leila Dillon, will host investor meetings at the Cantor Convergence Conference in Miami Beach, FL. Nicole will also participate in the panel “From Megawatts to Megaprojects: Building the Infrastructure for AI.” The conference will take place at The Ritz-Carlton, South Beach. ****


**About Ameresco, Inc.**


Ameresco, Inc. (NYSE: AMRC) is a leading energy infrastructure company delivering integrated solutions to create reliable power and modernize infrastructure. The company’s Power Infrastructure business integrates energy resources across behind-the-meter and utility-scale systems. Its Buildings & Public Infrastructure business modernizes the built environment with smart, connected solutions that optimize performance and enhance resilience. Ameresco is a trusted full lifecycle partner, delivering over $15 billion in solutions and contracting over 5 GW of energy resources since its founding in 2000. Headquartered in Massachusetts, Ameresco serves public and private sector customers across North America and Europe. Learn more at[www.ameresco.com](https://www.ameresco.com/) .
